question: After fresh current-head proof is supplied, must both Vercel projects produce successful previews before merge, or may their pre-build author-authorization failures be waived?
rationale: The dependency patch can be evaluated technically, but only maintainers can decide whether the external hosted-preview gate is mandatory for this site's release path.

options.title: Require both previews
options.body: Resolve Vercel author access and require successful exact-head deployments for both projects before merge.

options.title: Waive preview authorization
options.body: Accept fresh exact-head local browser and build proof while explicitly owning the risk that Vercel never exercised the deployment.

recommendation.title: Require both previews
recommendation.body: Resolve Vercel author access and require successful exact-head deployments for both projects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent rollback used successful Vercel deployments as the safety boundary for changes to these dependency files.
